responsibility: Implements the rs6000 machine-description patterns for VSX and newer vector-scalar instructions. It defines iterators, register-class mappings, load/store forms, scalar/vector floating-point arithmetic, conversions, permutes, direct moves, endian-fixup patterns, POWER8/POWER9 vector extensions, and peepholes for VSX-specific optimization, making it the main lowering file for VSX, scalar-in-VSX, and float128-in-vector-register code generation.
